articleTitle: Harnessing the Power of Transformer Networks in AI-Driven Decision Support Systems for Badminton Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research explores the application of hybrid transformer networks for video-based action recognition in sports specifically for badminton. This research aims to capture and classify badminton player movements with high accuracy. The novelty of this study lies in its hybrid transformer approach, a sophisticated blend of transformer architectures and self-supervised pretraining tasks, designed to process sequential image data, leveraging the spatial-temporal capabilities of transformer models to enhance feature extraction and reduce computational complexity. Initial experiments were conducted using a curated VideoBadminton dataset, achieving 86.2% CS accuracy and 92.9% CV accuracy, a promising increase in precision compared to traditional convolutional neural networks. This breakthrough indicates that hybrid transformer networks can significantly improve the accuracy in video-based badminton action recognition. The findings suggest a scalable path forward for integrating advanced AI methodologies into sports analytics for AI driven decision support system, offering substantial benefits for performance assessment and athlete development.

articleTitle: Risk Management Analysis on a Railways Electric Train Using ISO 31000:2018
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: It is usual for every institution to face various risks in achieving its goals and objectives when using Information Technology (IT). The risk that exists can result in financial losses, data loss, and even failure to achieve the organization. Railways Electric Train (RET) has implemented IT e-ticketing, offline ticketing, and the implementation of Information Systems (IS) to support operational activities because it already has minimum service standards and Standard Operational Procedure (SOP). Therefore, a risk management audit of the RET is necessary to achieve good governance. The method uses the framework of the International Standards Organization (ISO 31000: 2018). The study results identified 25 overall risks; 15 low-risk, nine medium-low risks, and one medium-high risk. RET recommends a need for particular action and attention to risk management, especially for nine low-level risks and one medium-high-level risk. The priority of risk is connectivity because it is unstable. After all, the scanning equipment for incoming and outgoing tickets has an error. The study recommendation hopes that the preparation of IT risk management documents can benefit the maximum sustainable use of information technology and anticipate risks.

articleTitle: VGG16 Model Architecture for Assessing Cucumber Ripeness Using Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Cucumber has a wide market in Indonesia, ranging from traditional markets to modern markets. According to National Statistics Center of Indonesia, cucumber production in 2016 reached 1,400,218 quintals or 140,021.8 tons. The demand for cucumbers increases yearly, but their availability decreases because the cultivation methods are not optimal. To produce optimal cucumber plants, starting with optimal seeds and achieving the right level of cucumber ripeness is essential. Farmers commonly determine the ripeness level of cucumbers, but this method is often inaccurate due to different perceptions and human visual limitations. This situation necessitates an identification process for classifying cucumbers into ripe and unripe categories using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) approach with VGG16 architecture. Using VGG16, a CNN model known for its depth and simplicity, provides an effective solution for this classification task. By training the model with 800 images and testing it with 200 images, the approach achieved an accuracy of 98.5%. It supports farmers in making better decisions, which leads to increased economic benefits for them.

articleTitle: Integration of Ishihara and Cambridge Methods for Multiplatform Color-Blindness Detection Using Cosine Similarity
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Color blindness is a hereditary condition that impacts an individual's capacity to differentiate colors. Currently, the Ishihara test, which is administered manually by an examiner, is used to detect this disorder. In this case manual testing still has drawbacks such as books that tear easily, colors that can fade, or books that can be lost. This study aims to develop a color blindness diagnosis system using the Ishihara and Cambridge methods with a multiplatform-based cosine similarity algorithm intended so that the general public can use this system. The Ishihara and Cambridge methods are used as an evaluation method to test the user's ability to recognize color patterns. While the cosine similarity algorithm is used to compare the user's answer with the predetermined answer key. Based on the results of the research, this system has succeeded in providing a diagnosis of color blindness with a high degree of similarity accuracy and has operated well. In addition, this system also makes it easy for users to access it through various platforms. This research plays an important role in the development of an effective and widely accessible color blindness diagnosis system.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Anti-Theft and Violation System with Keyless Ignition for Motorcycle
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Motorcycles are one of the most flexible means of transportation, especially in urban areas. Motorcycles are prone to theft. This is because access to ignition is easier than other vehicles such as cars. For this reason, a motorcycle security system was developed that has two main systems, namely a tracking system (vehicle tracker) and a keyless ignition system using a LoRa-based Smart SIM (e-driver License) card. The results of functionality and integration tests show that the entire system can be interconnected and work according to the system plan. Performance testing shows that the GPS module performs better when in open space conditions. The average time required by the system to start the vehicle using Smart SIM is 2.83 seconds, start the engine for 6.46 seconds, and turn off the vehicle for 5.18 seconds. The vibration sensor has a presentation error rate of 28% in detecting vibrations. The LoRa module has a greater transmission range in LOS (Line of Sight) conditions.

articleTitle: Digital Banking and Sustainable Financial Environment to Improve Financial Performance in SMEs: Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This systematic literature review aims to examine the role of digital banking and the development of a sustainable financial environment in enhancing the financial performance of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs). The review synthesizes existing research to highlight key findings, emerging themes, and gaps, providing a comprehensive understanding of how digital banking and sustainable financial practices impact SME financial performance.

articleTitle: Anticipating Computer Security Using the Snort Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the rapidly developing digital era, network servers have become an important part of an institution's IT infrastructure. Network servers play a vital role in providing Internet services to users, facilitating the exchange of information, and supporting the company's daily operations. However, as Internet activity grows, network servers have become targets for attackers with various methods. An intrusion detection system (IDS) is a system designed to detect and alert against suspicious activity or attacks that attempt to compromise network security. This research is expected to provide valuable contributions to improving computer network security and provide useful information about the importance of protecting network infrastructure from ever-increasing cyber threats. The purpose of this research is to optimize IDS using Snort and firewall on computer networks to prevent attacks from unauthorized. The results of this study are that an effective IDS can help prevent losses due to cyber attacks, including theft of sensitive data, service disruptions, and financial losses.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Data Augmentation Techniques on MobileNetV2 Performance in Tea Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research aims to analyze the performance comparison of MobileNetV2 with 32 different combinations of data augmentation in the classification of tea leaf diseases. Tea leaf diseases are divided into five categories: Red leaf spot, Algal leaf spot, Bird's eyespot, Gray blight, and Healthy. The research method utilizes data augmentation techniques to increase the variation and amount of training data, which is then implemented on image classification models using MobileNetV2. The results show that the variation in combinations of data augmentation techniques in a model does not affect changes in accuracy and loss as well as precision, recall, and F1-score in the classification model. The results also indicate that the use of augmentation techniques significantly affects the model's performance. Models with three and five augmentation techniques show very good results, while models with one and four augmentation techniques experience a decrease in performance. Some models show very good performance, with accuracy approaching the highest value. Model number 32, which uses 5 augmentation techniques (flip, rotation, translation, zoom, and contrast), has the highest accuracy (0.9867) and is considered the best candidate based on high performance and low loss value (0.0603), as well as showing high precision and recall simultaneously.

articleTitle: UI/UX Design of Integrated Farming System Using Goal-Directed Design
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the competitive field of digital product development, usability is a critical factor in determining an application's success, driven largely by the quality of its user interface (UI) and user experience (UX). Poor UI/UX applications often fail to maximize their functionality, leading to reduced user satisfaction and loyalty, which ultimately weakens their competitiveness in the market. Common issues with integrated farming systems (IFS) include non-intuitive interfaces, user-unfriendly designs, and inefficient performance-factors that negatively impact the overall user experience. This study aims to evaluate and redesign the UI/UX of IFS platforms facing usability challenges, focusing on user needs and improving the quality of interaction. The Goal-Directed Design (GDD) method was employed, which consists of six stages: Research, Modeling, Requirements, Framework, Refinement, and Support. The redesign results demonstrated significant improvements in usability attributes: Effectiveness increased from 76.67% to 100%, Efficiency from 68.52% to 100%, and Satisfaction from 51.45% to 84.05%. These scores were categorized as “Excellent” on adjective ratings and “High” on acceptable ratings. This study contributes valuable design recommendations and visual documentation that can assist developers in improving the UI/UX of IFS applications, ultimately leading to substantial improvements in user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Integration of IndoLEM and IndoBERT Models in Realtime Question Prediction in Customer Service Support
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research has a research object, namely predicting questions for real-time support services for customers. This research applies the IndoLEM and IndoBERT integration models. The use of these two models can develop the scientific discipline of natural language processing (NLP) which focuses on Indonesian. In the IndoLEM process, it will be used to group questions based on labels and perform vector representation on the data, while IndoBERT functions to understand the context and provide more relevant predictions. Testing was carried out in two stages, with the results showing an increase in accuracy from 83% in the first test to 90% in the second test. This improvement shows that the integration of the two models is effective in improving the system's ability to answer customer questions accurately and quickly. Challenges such as data suitability and increasing system complexity can be addressed through comprehensive optimization and validation. The results of this research show that the combination of IndoLEM and IndoBERT can significantly improve the quality of customer service by providing more efficient and relevant solutions. Thus, this integration model has the potential to be widely implemented in customer service systems in various sectors. This success underscores the importance of utilizing advanced NLP technology to improve customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, making service systems more responsive and adaptive to user needs

articleTitle: USeeTV TVOD Platform Recommendation System Optimization Using Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The most important thing here is finding out why the learner is quiet. If it's simply because they”re a quiet person who only speaks their mind when needed, then we can provide activities that require everyone to say something. However, if the person is quiet because they don't feel comfortable expressing their mind, we need to assure them that our learning session is a safe environment without any judgment. UseeTV”s TVOD platform is developing very rapidly. Due to these developments, the TVOD UseeTV platform has 172 channels with 41,131 content. Due to the large amount of content available, it is necessary to implement a recommendation system on the platform. This study used the content-based filtering method with TF-IDF and cosine similarity to create a recommendation system. However, TF-IDF still has problems, where the amount of feature space generated is still vast and sparse. To overcome this, we optimized TF-IDF usingSVD. Based on the study results, it has been proven that using SVD can improve the recommendation system's performance by increasing computing speed, which is two times faster. In addition, the average similarity score of the recommendation results is up to 4 times better when compared to the Recommendation System, which SVD does not optimize.

articleTitle: Exploring Key Factors Driving QR Payment Adoption in Digital Banking in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Technological progress within the banking industry has facilitated the extensive adoption of digital payment solutions, particularly those utilizing QR codes. Although these methods offer convenience and efficiency, significant hurdles remain in securing widespread consumer endorsement. This study analyzes factors influencing the intention to adopt QR payments, focusing on Perceived Ease of Use, Perceived Usefulness, Technology Readiness, Trust in Technology, and Behavioral Intention. Using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with SmartPLS, the study surveyed 400 digital banking users in Indonesia. Results reveal that perceived ease of use and usefulness significantly impact behavioral intention to adopt QR payments. Additionally, tech-nology readiness and trust in technology are critical drivers of adoption. The findings emphasize that enhancing QR payment adoption requires not only technological advancements but also ensuring user-friendliness and trust, which are statistically signif-icant factors in driving adoption, as demonstrated by the p-value <0.01 in our analysis.

articleTitle: Volatility Technology and Environmental Sustainability to Improve Green Innovation in Small Medium Enterprises: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This analysis Bibliometric Study examines the intersection of volatility, technology, and environmental sustainability in enhancing green innovation among Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). The review aims to identify key trends, challenges, and strategies that enable SMEs to adopt green innovation practices effectively. By analyzing a range of scholarly articles, this study provides a comprehensive understanding of how SMEs can leverage technological advancements and navigate environmental volatility to achieve sustainable growth. The review finds that market and environmental volatility can compel SMEs to adopt new technologies and sustainable practices for business continuity. Conversely, investments in green technologies and effective environmental management can help SMEs manage volatility better. Collaboration between SMEs, research institutions, and policymakers is crucial in creating an enabling environment for green innovation in SMEs. The review highlights the need for a holistic approach integrating technological, organizational, and policy-level interventions to support SMEs’ transition towards environmental sustainability and long-term competitiveness.

articleTitle: Digital Governance Strategies for Enhancing Sustainable Banking Ecosystem in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The digital revolution has flooded nearly every industry, including the banking sector. This infiltration has manifested in innovative digital service technologies, such as mobile banking, and other advancements. The rapid integration of technology in banking, while offering numerous advantages, also introduces complex challenges for governance. Information security and cybercrime in the banking industry have become a critical issue. It cannot be denied, in this digital transformation era, cyber risk has become a frightening threat. This study aims to provide more insight into the digital governance framework in the Indonesia banking sector to ensure a sustainable banking system. This is a conceptual paper based on related literatures.

articleTitle: Developing Sensor of a Water Level Control Prototype Using Fuzzy Logic Based on Soil Moisture Levels with Internet of Things Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: High rainfall in Indonesia increases the risk of flooding, especially in irrigation areas. Overcoming flooding and standing water can be maintained by using water control automation tools. This automation tool adopts the fuzzy logic method to determine the ideal water level, the HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor to measure the water level, the YL69 soil moisture sensor to measure soil moisture, and a submersible pump to actuate the water. After the fuzzy logic determines the ideal water level, the submersible pump will respond according to the results obtained. If the water level is below the perfect water level, the submersible pump will add water to the container. Conversely, if the water level exceeds the ideal, the submersible pump will reduce the volume of water in the container. The fuzzy logic used is Mamdani fuzzy logic with an accuracy rate of 96,022%. The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor used has a water level measurement accuracy of 90.003% and the YL69 soil moisture sensor used has a measurement accuracy of 96,906%.

articleTitle: Redesigning UI/UX of A Complaint Service Mobile Application Using Goal-Directed Method
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Public information disclosure at a university is vital for transparency and accountability. IT unit of the institution plays a key role in facilitating information access, but challenges persist in providing optimal service and website usability. This study redesigns user interface/user experience (UI/UX) of a complaint mobile application for the IT unit using goal-directed design (GDD) and compares its usability with the existing website. GDD involves stages such as research, modeling, requirements, framework, refinement, and support. Usability evaluation is conducted using the techniques of retrospective think-aloud (RTA) and the system usability scale (SUS). Interview results highlight issues like unintegrated features, difficulty in tracking status, and insufficient feedback. Solutions include adding progress-tracking features and user accounts. Testing indicates a significant increase in usability after the redesign, with maze testing scores rising from around 43.5 to about 90.75, and SUS from approximately 40.3 to around 80.55. Retrospective think-aloud sessions show an increase in positive comments from about 2.8% to above 80.6%. Future research could explore design improvements from other stakeholders’ perspectives.

articleTitle: Comparison of You Only Look Once (YOLO) Algorithm Version 5 and Version 8 as Object Detection in Hilal Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The determination of the beginning of Ramadan is an important event for Muslims in Indonesia to start fasting. This date is determined by two stages, namely the hisab method based on the date and the rukyhat method based on hilal observation. However, the rukyhat method often faces difficulties due to many challenges such as human visual limitations. This research suggests the use of You Only Look Once (YOLO), a deep learning-based object detection system, as a new approach to assist hilal observation. The system is designed to detect the hilal accurately, even under difficult observation conditions. The application of YOLO is expected to help religious authorities overcome obstacles in the rukhyat method and increase the precision of observations. Preliminary results show that the system is able to detect the crescent moon with a high success rate, showing good potential for integrating technology into the religious domain.

articleTitle: Analysis of User Satisfaction of Provider Applications Using Technology Acceptance Model and End User Computing Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: One of the key factors affecting the success of a system or application is user satisfaction. User satisfaction refers to the condition where users feel content with their experience using a product or service. This study aims to assess the satisfaction levels of By. U. Application users and identify the factors that can help increase the user base to meet the target. The research adopts the TAM and EUCS methods, modified by including the system speed variable. Population of the study consists of By. U-app users who reside in the Jabodetabek region. A purposive sample of 400 people was chosen to participate. The analysis used the PLS-SEM method with the SmartPLS version 4 software. With an average score of 4.03, the results show that user satisfaction with the By. U application is typically excellent. Six hypotheses-system speed, user attitude, perceived utility, perceived ease of use, content, and overall ease of use-were also validated. However, three hypotheses were rejected due to t-test values below 1.96, namely accuracy (0.259), format (1.187), and timeliness (0.487). Additionally, changes in the application's interface design, as part of the proposed improvements, are suggested to help. By. U consider adding features needed by users. The study's goal is to reach 25 million downloads by December 2024, primarily targeting Generation Z.

articleTitle: Vocal Type Classification Model Using CNN with Mel Spectrogram Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research presents the implementation of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model for classifying vocal types based on Mel Spectrogram feature extraction, combined with data augmentation techniques. The dataset consists of 399 vocal recordings categorized into four vocal types: alto, soprano, bass, and tenor. Data augmentation was applied to enhance the dataset with five audio effects: reverb, chorus, delay, compressor, and clipping, resulting in a total of 2,394 augmented samples. The proposed CNN model was trained using 10-fold cross-validation with a training-to-validation ratio of 9:1. The model's performance was evaluated both with and without data augmentation. The results demonstrated that the model with data augmentation achieved a testing accuracy of 99.06%, while the model without augmentation achieved 95.58%. This research confirms that data augmentation significantly improves the classification accuracy of vocal types.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Macro Keys as Minimalist Keyboard with Kbfirmware Based on Arduino Pro Micro
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The third-generation computer is the first computer that allows users to interact with keyboards and monitors. A keyboard is a hardware device used to enter letters, numbers, special characters, and commands into a computer. In Indonesia, the most commonly used layout is QWERTY, which was adopted from the typewriter layout created by Christopher Latham Sholes in 1868. While functional, using a mouse can limit keyboard accessibility. This research aims to develop an Arduino Pro Micro-based Multi-Layer Minimalist Keyboard, designed to optimize keyboard functionality by offering customizable key mappings and macros for repeated tasks. This minimalist keyboard allows users to execute shortcuts and complex commands with a single keypress, thereby improving workflow efficiency. The multilayer feature extends the keyboard's functionality beyond its physical buttons. This research employs Visual Studio Code for program writing, which is later converted using kbfirmware and flashed into the Arduino Pro Micro via QMK Toolbox. The prototype has been tested using Black Box Testing, showing a 100% success rate in key mapping functionality and macro execution. The results demonstrate that this minimalist keyboard significantly enhances user efficiency, particularly for repetitive tasks and shortcuts, making it a viable solution for improving user interaction with computer systems.

articleTitle: FHRP Performance Measurement Using Etherchannel and Routing protocol OSPFv2, IGRP and BGPv4 on Three-Tier Enterprise Network Architecture Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Networks in enterprise scale require connectivity that runs continuously so that a backup network is needed that functions as a substitute for the main network in case of problems. Network problems can affect data traffic and Quality. This can be overcome by using a gateway redundancy protocol. To determine the performance of a computer network when switching from the main network to the backup network, performance measurements are needed. Performance measurements are carried out with several scenarios using TCP and UDP packet transmissions to determine the value of Quality of Service, namely Throughput, Jitter, Packet loss and Delay. The results of this study show a comparison of protocol redundancy (FHRP) using EIGRP and OSPF routing by producing the HSRP protocol has the best QoS performance using EIGRP and OSPF routing but has a delay value that is slightly not better than other combinations in several scenarios

articleTitle: Consumer Attitude and Purchase Behaviour Toward Artificial Intelligence-Based Features in Smart Hotel Mobile Apps
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The influence of a smart hotel mobile app on customer acquisition can be significant, as it can enhance the overall consumer experience and provide unique value propositions that attract and retain customers. Developing a smart hotel app involves several key steps to ensure that the app meets the needs of both the hotel management and the guests. A well-designed and feature-rich smart hotel app can play a crucial role in customer acquisition by offering convenience, personalization, communication, and value-added services that enhance the overall guest experience and differentiate the hotel from competitors. With a quantitative approach, this research aims to determine the effect of AI features in smart hotel mobile apps on consumer attitude (user experience evaluation, technology user-friendliness, and information clarity) and customer purchase behaviour. This research will help hoteliers and developers design and optimize smart apps to meet their target audience's needs and expectations effectively.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Muslim Pro “A1-Quran Adzan” on Google Play Using Multinomial Naïve Bayes
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This paper aims to conduct sentiment analysis on the Muslim Pro application on Google Play using the Multinomial Naive Bayes method. The underlying problem of this research is the difficulty users face in managing and understanding the information from the numerous reviews. With over 100 million downloads, developers must understand user sentiment to improve the application according to their needs. The dataset used consists of 3,000 reviews, which are classified into positive and negative reviews based on user ratings. The data preprocessing process includes case folding, tokenization, normalization, stopword removal, and stemming. The division of training data and test data in this study is 80:20. The results of the study show that the Multinomial Naive Bayes method achieves an accuracy of 90%, with a precision of 92%, a recall of 91%, and an F1 score of 92%. These results indicate that the Multinomial Naive Bayes method effectively classifies reviews of the Muslim Pro application, assisting the company in making effective decisions and developing an application that meets user needs.

articleTitle: Designing Information Security Risk Management Policies in an E-Government System Using TOGAF Enterprise Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The e-Government system provides opportunities to enhance collaboration among government agencies in carrying out governmental affairs and tasks to achieve common goals. Risk management and information security are aspects that can influence the e-Government index in a region. A local government organization is tasked with ensuring that risk management and information security are well implemented in its jurisdiction. However, until now, there has been no specific policy governing risk management within this organization. This research aims to design a risk management policy for the local government organization in the form of a Regent Regulation. The research stages include integrating standards related to risk management and information security, namely ISO 27001:2022, ISO 31000:2018, and SABSA with TOGAF Enterprise Architecture (EA) based on the integration results by The Open Group. Then, the content of the policy is determined and drafted into a Regent Regulation Draft based on the legal product formation format generally applicable in Indonesia and specifically in the region. This research results in a recommended document of the Regent Regulation Draft on Risk Management for the local government organization. This study is expected to help optimize the risk management implementation in the local government organization environment, thereby Improving the readiness of e-Government in the region.

articleTitle: Comparison of Elbow, Silhouette and DBI Methods for Clustering Nutritional Status of Toddlers Using K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Nutritional status is a measure of a person's health condition as seen from the food consumed. The implementation of nutritional monitoring or nutritional surveillance at the Community Health Center begins with data collection and reporting of toddler nutritional status with the Electronic Community-Based Nutrition Recording and Reporting System (E-PPGBM), the recording process must input toddler data from each integrated health post so that the process takes a long time until each integrated health post has measured each toddler. Furthermore, the data is processed and analyzed with Excel to produce a health information report in the form of toddler nutritional status data from each integrated health post which is reported to the health office. In the final process, namely dissemination, namely decision making for follow-up actions to carry out nutritional improvement programs. The nutritional surveillance process still has motivational constraints and performance becomes less than optimal, such as late reporting and coaching because all implementation processes are only carried out by one health center nutrition officer. The health center needs a data clustering system for the nutritional status of toddlers at each integrated health post to facilitate the decision-making process and monitoring of the nutritional health of each integrated health post so that information can be obtained to help nutrition officers prioritize integrated health posts for nutritional improvement service programs in order to achieve improvements in the nutritional health of toddlers at the Abadijaya Health Center. Evaluation of the number of optimal clusters using the Elbow, Silhouette, and Davies Bouldin Index (DBI) methods. The Elbow method obtained 4 optimal clusters, while the Silhouette method obtained 2 optimal clusters and the Davies Bouldin Index (DBI) obtained 2 clusters.

articleTitle: Evaluation of User Interface of Mobile Applications Using the User Experience Questionnaire Method
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The sampled health application is a health application that provides information about health, medicine, and also health aids that are of interest to its users. This ease and efficiency in searching for information about health makes the application. Based on the reviews obtained on the Google Play store application, several users complained about problems in using the application facilities, then regarding menu navigation problems where users still experienced confusion in navigating the application, finally there was the responsiveness problem of the menu or interface which sometimes had problems such as error or stuck in using the application then the application closes by itself. Based on the review there is a lack of user experience in the application and users still lack evaluation in improving their user experience. Hence, some users still have problems using the application even though this could have been avoided or evaluated beforehand. The aim of the research carried out in the sampled application is to find out problem points in the user experience in the application and get the latest evaluation using the user experience questionnaire (UEQ) method. The results of this research can explain that the aspect of the user experience questionnaire scale in the clarity scale occupies the first level or gets a very high average result, namely 2.41; while the novelty scale occupies the lowest position with an average value of 1.75. Based on the value of the novelty scale which was still low, design improvements were made which included the appearance of the doctor's chat menu or doctor's consultation based on the novelty scale.

articleTitle: User Experience Assessment of LPG 3 kg Distribution System Using User Experience Questionnaire for Tax Payment Simplification
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: 3kg LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) in Indonesia needs help determining who can use it, how to distribute it, and keeping prices from exceeding government standards. From the gas agent's side, tax payments for all transactions still use the manual method and manually determining distribution channels, which impacts to transportation costs. The existence of a 3kg LPG gas distribution web-based system developed can solve problems from the gas agent's side. For this reason, we determine the evaluation of user experience (UX), namely the gas agent, gas base, and the drivers. This research aims to assess user experience (UX) by conducting UX evaluations using the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ). We selected Fifty samples from all 101 users. It then entered into the UEQ for calculation to obtain the final excellent score. The results for five variables are excellents: Attractiveness 2.140, Perspicuity 2.075, Efficiency 2.110, Stimulation 1.800, and Novelty 2.023. The final score for dependability is good with result 1.685. Overall, the web system built has a final score of excellent because it can provide excellent UX to its users.

articleTitle: The Role of Paid Promotions and Organic Engagement in Financial Decision Making for Social Media Strategies Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study analyzes factors influencing user engagement on a cosmetics brand's Facebook page and predicts total interactions using machine learning models. The dataset includes metrics such as user engagement, post reach, impressions, content types, paid promotions, and interactions (likes, comments, shares). Data preprocessing involves handling missing values, encoding categorical variables, and normalizing features for predictive modeling. Three machine learning algorithms-Linear Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost-are used to predict interactions, with a Stacking Regressor model combining Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Regressor (SVR) for enhanced predictions. Model performance is evaluated using Mean Squared Error (MSE) and R-squared (R2). Feature importance analysis identifies the most influential variables, with Lifetime Engaged Users having the highest impact (correlation of 0.85, feature importance score of 35%), followed by Paid Promotions (25%) and Post Reach (20%). The Stacking Regressor outperforms other models, achieving the lowest MSE (9,432.3) and highest R-squared (0.90), compared to Linear Regression with an MSE of 15,432.2 and R-squared of 0.72. The study suggests that brands focus on engaging content and leverage paid promotions to extend reach, utilizing predictive models to enhance marketing strategies. Further research is recommended to validate this approach across other platforms and industries.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of User Interface and User Experience Using Design Science Research Methodology: A Case Study of the Quranic Reading and Writing Application
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Reading and writing the Quran is a fundamental practice for Muslims worldwide. However, with the limitations of time, resources, and busy academic schedules, many Muslim students struggle to develop these essential skills. This research aims to design an intuitive and efficient Quran reading and writing application using User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) principles. The study employs the Design Science Research Methodology (DSRM) to guide the development of the application. The research identifies the user needs through literature reviews, questionnaires, and interviews and presents a high-fidelity prototype that improves usability and engagement. Results indicate the application effectively meets the needs of users and provides a more attractive, efficient, and user-friendly experience.

articleTitle: Assessing the Accuracy of Object Detection and Image to Text Conversion on Motor Vehicle Number Plate Using YOLOv5 and PaddleOCR
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Object detection and image conversion to text is a widely used technology, with various applications, including the detection of Motor Vehicle Number Plate (TNKB) and conversion of the image to text. This research aims to understand how to create a TNKB detection and image conversion system and measure accuracy in the process of object detection and image to text conversion in TNKB. The research uses the YOLOv5 algorithm for object detection and the PaddleOCR library to convert TNKB images into text. The development method that is being used are CRISP-DM. This research involved the use of 298 images of four- wheeled motorized vehicles obtained from various sources, including Google Image Search, Instagram, and the government auction website lelang.go.id This data is used to train the YOLOv5 model. In addition, 40 images of four-wheeled motorized vehicles from the same source were used for testing. The research results show that the YOLOv5 algorithm achieves detection accuracy of 95%, while PaddleOCR's accuracy in converting TNKB images into text reaches 75%.

articleTitle: Systematic Literature Review: Social Media Usage in Generation Z from the Perspective of Digital Ethics and Islamic Ethics
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The development of information technology has made a shift from conventional media to digital media. It is undeniable that the use of social media not only provide the positive benefits but also has some negative effects especially to those who have lack of digital literacy. Generation Z, who currently on teenage and young adult phase, is widely known to have limitation on selecting or sorting content and criticizing information on the social media. The research questions of this review are: how does the generation Z use social media from the perspective of digital and Islamic ethics and what platform trends are mostly used? This research uses a systematic literature review method to assess the use of Generation Z social media from the perspective of digital ethics and Islam. The systematic search method was conducted on several data sources using keywords: digital literacy, digital ethics, Islamic ethics, Islam, social media, generation Z, and information technology. As the result, Generation Z manages the ethical barriers by combining modern digital practices with Islamic values. However, issues emerge in areas like excessive sharing of personal details, exposure to harmful content, and the possibility of engaging in online activities that conflict with Islamic.

articleTitle: Live Streaming on Marketplace: User Experience, Credibility, Parasocial Interaction Toward Purchase Intention
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The rise in internet users has prompted individuals to become live streamers and promote products through online market places. Live streaming creates a unique attraction and holds the potential to influence consumer purchasing decisions. This study aims to identify the key factors that marketers should focus on when promoting their products in order to enhance consumer purchase intentions. This research employs a quantitative survey method by distributing questionnaires to marketplace consumers who have both watched live streams and made purchases on the platform. Testing using a Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) shows the results The factors influencing consumer purchase intentions are crucial aspects that marketers must carefully consider. which shows the influence between user experience, credibility, parasocial interaction on purchase intention. Therefore, user experience, credibility, and parasocial interaction must be considered by digital marketers in the marketplace to increase consumer purchase intention. This study is expected to provide managerial influence in the form of contributions to the marketplace regarding how effective live streaming digital marketing can reach consumers and inform them about new products, offers, discounts, or promotions that increase conversion rates in the marketplace.

articleTitle: Deepfake Video Classification Using Random Forest and Stochastic Gradient Descent with Triplet Loss Approach Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The current technology on the internet, one of them is the rapid development of deepfake creation. Alongside the ease of generating deepfake videos by manipulating someone's face, this can lead to various detrimental issues such as spreading misinformation, disseminating fake news, and other cybercrime problems. Therefore, the author proposes a method capable of predicting and classifying whether a video is a deepfake or genuine using the Triplet Loss Approach with Random Forest and Stochastic Gradient Descent as classification algorithms. This approach employs the Multi-task Cascaded Convolutional Network (MTCNN) to detect and extract facial embeddings from the video frames. The model is trained and validated on a total of 600 videos, each consisting of 30, 50 and 70 frames respectively. The test in this research shows that the best Triplet Loss model with RF Classifier have higher result in terms of accuracy in comparison with SGD Classifier, with the average accuracy score of 0.84, AUC 0.8987, EER 0.2, Precision 0.9045, Recall 0.76, F1 Score 0.82545 while SGD Classifier have the average accuracy of 0.82, AUC 0.9104, EER 0.1799, Precision 0.8633, Recall 0.76, F1 Score 0.8079 in a form of 30 frames.

articleTitle: Designing Information Security Risk Management Policies in an e-Government System Using TOGAF Enterprise Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The e-Government system provides opportunities to enhance collaboration among government agencies in carrying out governmental affairs and tasks to achieve common goals. Risk management and information security are aspects that can influence the e-Government index in a region. A local government organization is tasked with ensuring that risk management and information security are well implemented in its jurisdiction. However, until now, there has been no specific policy governing risk management within this organization. This research aims to design a risk management policy for the local government organization in the form of a Regent Regulation. The research stages include integrating standards related to risk management and information security, namely ISO 27001:2022, ISO 31000:2018, and SABSA with TOGAF Enterprise Architecture (EA) based on the integration results by The Open Group. Then, the content of the policy is determined and drafted into a Regent Regulation Draft based on the legal product formation format generally applicable in Indonesia and specifically in the region. This research results in a recommended document of the Regent Regulation Draft on Risk Management for the local government organization. This study is expected to help optimize the risk management implementation in the local government organization environment, thereby improving the readiness of e-Government in the region,

articleTitle: Evaluating Usability of E-Commerce Application Using System Usability Scale Questionnaires
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The growth of e-commerce use has snowballed since its emergence, especially since the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic in the last 2020s. One of the e-commerce applications in Indonesia is SOCO by Sociolla. Although the researchers observed that this application is one of the most popular beauty e-commerce applications in Indonesia, there are only a few unfavorable assessments regarding its ease of use of this application. Of course, this assessment depends on the user experience when using it. The usability aspect of using an application is the key to the success of the application itself. This study aimed to evaluate the e-commerce mentioned above application using system usability scale (SUS) questionnaires involving around 20 participants. The results demonstrated the final evaluation result obtained a SUS value of 71.38. The results presented that users of the sampled e-commerce application accepted with a high average level (high marginal) and fair assessment criteria on adjective rating.

articleTitle: Optimizing Waste Management Operational Performance Through the Use of a Blockchain Technology Model
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Waste management encompasses a range of tasks including gathering, moving, handling, and reusing waste products. Reducing the harmful effects of trash on the environment and people is the goal of waste management. In this process, different waste types are sorted, and reduction, reuse, recycling, and management guidelines are applied based on the unique qualities of each waste type. The issue with the current trash management system is that it lacks transparency with regard to the garbage's place of origin, its distribution routes, and its transfer from the waste source to the recycling management facility. Transparency in identifying the gathered waste at its source and distribution routes is lacking. Therefore, the goal of this project is to use blockchain technology to boost waste management's transparency. By utilizing peer-to-peer validation from all parties involved in waste management, blockchain technology can offer a high degree of transparency in garbage management. Data security is provided by blockchain technology in waste management because of its unchangeable principles. The study's output is a model for implementing blockchain technology and Hyperledger simulation in trash management.

articleTitle: Assessing the Performance of an E-Wallet Application Using Usability Testing Criteria
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The development of information and communication technology has had a major impact on the transformation of online transaction activities, especially amid the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic which first occurred at the end of the 2019 decade. One of the online transaction applications in Indonesia is the XYZ application. Although this application is one of the most popular e-wallets in Indonesia, there are only a few unfavorable ratings regarding its user experience and user intarface. The usability factor is an important aspect of the success of the application. This study aimed to evaluate the usability level of the e-wallet application based on aspects of learnability, efficiency, error, memorability, and satisfaction level by involving 26 participants. The measurement results on the application show that the final evaluation results obtain a qualification score of 85%-100%. This shows that the application can be useful for users in a good category.

articleTitle: The Development of a Field Service Management Information System to Help Companies Manage Field Workers: Proposed Prototype
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Proper field service management (FSM) is critical for businesses with many field personnel to enhance operational efficiency. While FSM systems have improved operational efficiency, existing solutions often lack real-time data integration and advanced analytics capabilities. This research proposes a novel FSM prototype leveraging digital twin technology to address these limitations. The prototype integrates IoT sensors, real-time data analytics, and 3D visualization to create a virtual replica of field operations. However, controlling these personnel's field operations is dynamic and requires real-time data, making it difficult to manage effectively. The goal is to develop a user-friendly and efficient FSM software that uses digital twins for real-time monitoring, tracking, and optimizing field operations. This research employs the Rapid Application Development (RAD) methodology, which is particularly suitable for developing prototypes. The prototype FSM enhances field worker management by offering a comprehensive picture of operations, maintenance planning, and real-time data analytics. This research contributes to the growing body of work on digital twin applications in service management.

articleTitle: How Important is Security Authentication in the Mobile Payment System
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Mobile payment (M-Payment) is a means of non-cash payment using a smartphone device that utilizes various wireless technology media such as QR codes, NFC, and OTP codes. This mobile-based payment model is a payment method that offers convenience, efficiency, effectiveness, compatibility, and convenience. However, mobile payments come with significant risks, considering they are electronic and wireless. Therefore, authentication is required in payments. Even though the technological requirements for secure mobile payments have been met according to standards, there are still security gaps that unauthorized persons can penetrate. Therefore, this paper proposes an anonymous authentication and management flow for mobile payments to support transaction security, prevent user information disclosure, and reduce identity theft. The use of transaction keys, encryption and decryption, and matching to process user personal information based on the authentication operator's mobile equipment using an asymmetric algorithm is deemed appropriate.

articleTitle: Analysis of User Acceptance for Online Food & Drink Application Using the UTAUT 2 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Tomoro Coffe launched an application that can make it easier for users to order food and beverages online. This application was chosen as the object of research because it still has a small number of users when compared to other applications. To find out the reason for the low use of this application, the researcher conducted a pre-research in the form of a questionnaire. Based on the results of the pre- research questionnaire that has been disseminated, there are various reasons and perceptions in stating the reasons for using the Tomoro Coffee application. This proves that everyone has a different perception in using related applications. The model used in this study is UTAUT 2 with the addition of the perceived trust variable. This model is selected based on a predefined problem with the addition of variables that can define a sense of security when using an application. The results show that the model has been significantly proven to be correct and accepted in this study. From 11 hypotheses that have been proposed, 10 hypotheses are accepted and significant, while 1 other hypothesis (BI→UB) is rejected and insignificant because the t-statistics and p-values of the related hypotheses are less than 1.96 and 0.1. This study provides an understanding of the factors that affect the behavior of Tomoro Coffee application users in the Greater Jakarta area. This can be useful for Tomoro Coffee to be able to increase user acceptance in the region.

articleTitle: Enhancing Educational Games: Addressing Design Challenges and Improving Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: As technology advances, educational games have emerged as an interactive and effective learning tool, combining entertainment and education to enhance student engagement. However, challenges such as complex user interfaces, excessive cognitive load, and low student motivation limit the full potential of these games. This study addresses these issues by proposing targeted solutions to simplify interface design, manage cognitive load, and improve student engagement. Through a comprehensive literature review, the research explores integrating Gestalt principles in the UX design of educational games to support effective learning. By examining academic sources, books, and web articles, the study highlights how design principles like proximity, similarity, and closure can enhance user experience and emotional engagement. The findings provide valuable insights into improving educational games' usability and emotional impact through effective UX design, ultimately contributing to deeper, more meaningful learning experiences. This research offers practical guidance for educators and developers aiming to optimize educational games, making them more effective tools for fostering engagement and enhancing learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Improved LOPCOW-SAW Method for Optimal Supplier Selection in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Supplier selection is a critical component of Supply Chain Management (SCM), as suppliers provide raw materials or services essential for supporting a company's operations. Traditional supplier selection methods often rely on subjective assessments to determine the weighting of criteria, which can lead to biases and suboptimal decision making. To address this issue, this study combines the Logarithmic Percentage Change of Weight (LOPCOW) method with the Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) method to enhance objectivity in the supplier selection process. The LOPCOW method is used to assign criterion weights objectively based on logarithmic percentage changes, which helps minimize subjectivity, These weights are then applied using the SAW method to evaluate and rank suppliers. The results of the study show that this combined approach is more reliable for selecting suppliers objectively and accurately. The study suggests integrating other Multi-Criteria Decision-Making (MCDM) methods to further strengthen the results while recommending the inclusion of real-time data analytics to improve the model's adaptability to dynamic market conditions. The LOPCOW-SAW approach can be applied across various industries for more effective and efficient SCM supplier selection.

articleTitle: Classification of Human Voice Types Using Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm with Extraction of Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Detection of human voice types in the context of choir as a learning medium using CNN and MFCC. This research aims to classify the type of human voice so that it can be divided into four labels, namely soprano, Alto, tenor, and Bass. This research uses CRISP-DM as the research method with the Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) algorithm and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The data used were 1200 data obtained from similar research and 40 directly recorded data. This research shows that the CNN algorithm can detect the type of voice by obtaining an accuracy value of 94.08%.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Platform Information Systems Web-Based Streaming on Muse Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Muse Indonesia has become Indonesia;s first legal anime streaming service, addressing the demand for accessible digital entertainment. Unlike other streaming platforms, Muse Indonesia delivers content through YouTube channels, where limitations in search and categorization hinder optimal user experience for anime viewers. These limitations create challenges for users seeking specific anime types, as the current search and grouping features on YouTube do not fully meet user needs. This indicates the potential value of an additional, web-based streaming platform tailored specifically to anime content. This research aims to analyze and design a web-based information system for Muse Indonesia's streaming needs, utilizing the Rapid Application Development (RAD) method in conjunction with Unified Modeling Language (UML) for structured modeling. The outcome of this study is a comprehensive design blueprint that Muse Indonesia can leverage as a foundation for developing an independent streaming platform. This blueprint offers practical guidelines for enhancing content accessibility, navigation, and user satisfaction., laying the groundwork for future platform development.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement Technique of RSA Algorithm in Document Data Security
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: One of the first public key schemes was developed in 1977 by Ron Rivest, Adi Shamir, and Len Adleman at MIT and first published in 1978. Since then, the RSA scheme has become the most widely accepted and applied public-key encryption approach. RSA is a block cipher where the plaintext and ciphertext are integers between 0 and n - 1 for some <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex>. However, since the calculations involved (both in key generation and in encryption/decryption) are complex, the larger the key size, the slower the system will run. To overcome the performance constraints of the RSA algorithm, various techniques such as iteration, Divide and Conquer, and Square and Multiply have been developed. Tests were conducted on files with various key lengths to evaluate encryption and decryption performance. The results show that all three algorithms experience an increase in computation time as the key length increases. The iteration algorithm shows the best performance for short keys, while the square and multiply algorithm provides the highest efficiency for medium to long keys. Further testing recommends using square and multiply for keys of 128 bits and above due to its superior efficiency. It can be concluded that the selection of appropriate support algorithms can overcome RSA's performance issues without compromising security, as well as provide suggestions for further security analysis and development of more efficient algorithms.

articleTitle: Computational Mathematics of Risk and Return Portofolio Banking (Ramadhan Effect 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Financial engineering combines a rigorous study of computational mathematics with economics and quantitative finance. This research was conducted to analyze the level of risk and return of banking stock portfolios after the Ramadan effect. This research uses a descriptive event study method by calculating the 3 most profitable stocks in the banking sector to be used as a portfolio with a weight of 33% each. The results showed that the expected return for the banking portfolio was 0.27% and the predicted risk in the next period was 1.46%. These results have been calculated carefully to provide an illustration that investors who want to buy a portfolio of banking shares do not need to worry about future returns

articleTitle: Plagiarism Detection Application with Modified Enhanced Confix Stripping - Levenshtein Distance Algorithm Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research is made to continue the research on Implementation of Levensthein Distance Algorithm on Plagiarism Detection. In that research, it is found that the application can calculate the percentage of plagiarism against 2 documents, and it is suggested for further research to include the stemming algorithm to increase the percentage of plagiarism. This study uses the stemming algorithm of Modified Enhanced Confix Stripping (MECS) to prove the suggestion written in previous research. The study was conducted by comparing plagiarism percentage, system usage, running time, and complexity of Levensthein and MECS - Levensthein algorithm. The result of this research is the use of MECS algorithm can reduce running time by 7s, but the percentage decreased by 0,8% and system usage increased by 11,72%.

articleTitle: Classification Fracture in X-ray Images Using VGG16 Feature Extraction and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Classifying X-ray images to detect fractures is a challenge due to the high complexity of the data. X-ray data have significant variations in texture and intensity, as well as the large number of fracture types that need to be detected, making the classification task difficult. This research used VGG16 feature extraction techniques and principal component analysis (PCA). This study uses VGG16 to capture essential patterns in X-ray images, aiming to improve classification accuracy by utilising VGG16's ability to detect complex features. PCA reduces data dimensions, reduces complexity and computational time, and avoids overfitting. Two models were built and compared: the first used the VGG16 with PCA, and the second used the VGG16 without PCA. The data set consisted of 1521 X-ray images with 12 different types of fracture. The experimental results showed that the CNN model with PCA achieved 94% accuracy, while the CNN model without PCA achieved 95% accuracy. This indicates that PCA does not necessarily improve the classification accuracy in large and diverse datasets, whereas CNNs without PCA perform best in fracture classification.

articleTitle: From Theory to Practice: Agile Methodologies in IT Service Management
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of IT services, traditional IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks often struggle to keep pace with the dynamic needs of businesses. This paper explores the integration of agile principles into ITSM practices to enhance flexibility, responsiveness, and overall service delivery. Utilizing a real-world case study from a leading technology firm, this study examines the process of embedding agile methodologies-such as Scrum and Kanban-into existing ITSM frameworks. The objective is to demonstrate how agile practices can be harmonized with ITSM to address the challenges of maintaining service quality in the face of continuous change. Data were collected through a combination of interviews, direct observations, and analysis of service performance metrics before and after the integration. Key findings reveal significant improvements in service response times, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction. However, the integration also posed challenges, particularly in aligning Agile's iterative nature with ITSM's structured processes. The implications of these findings suggest that while Agile principles can greatly enhance ITSM, careful consideration of organizational culture and process adaptation is essential for successful implementation.

articleTitle: News Recommendation System Using Apriori Algorithm and Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: There is a lot of news available on online news portals, but peoples are difficult to find the suitable information that aligns with their preferences. This highlights the importance of developing systems that can help people access news more efficiently and relevantly. This research applies a content-based filtering method that utilizes association rules to identify patterns or associations among news keywords in the dataset. The Apriori algorithm finds frequent item sets from news keywords, which are then utilized in a recommendation system model. This research uses news data from the news portals Detik.com, Kompas, and CNN Indonesia. This research successfully developed a news recommendation system using association rules and the Apriori algorithm, achieving a precision of 74%, recall of 68%, and an F-1 Score of 0.72.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Coconut Quality Classification Using the Pretrained Model Efficientnet
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Indonesia is the country with the largest coconut production in the world. Currently, there are coconut producers in Indonesia who still use manual methods to classify coconuts This manual method costs a lot of time and is prone to classification errors. Computer vision provides a solution to this problem through image classification. This research uses transfer learning techniques on the pretrained model EfficientNet for automatic coconut quality classification. This research aims to determine the results and influence of model performance based on 12 modeling scenarios, including the use of dropout layers as well as several learning rates and optimizer values used in this research. The best scenario results were obtained by using dropout, learning rate 0.001, and RMSprop optimizer, with 94,4% accuracy, 94,7% precision, 94,4% recall, and 94,5% f1-score with the ability to detect images within 90 milliseconds.

articleTitle: E-Recruitment with AI in GHRM for Corporate University Sustainability to Improve Organization Performance: Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This comprehensive and systematic literature review meticulously examines the intricate fusion and integration of various electronic recruitment methodologies, which are increasingly being utilized in conjunction with advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, all within the expansive framework of global human resource management (GHRM), with the overarching objective of promoting and fostering sustainability within corporate universities. The review aims to understand how these technologies impact organizational performance and sustainability initiatives. It investigates how these digital tools enable organizations to streamline recruitment processes, enhance candidate screening and selection, and promote diversity and inclusion in the global talent pool. The review also explores the role of e-recruitment and AI in supporting corporate university programs, which are critical for developing a skilled and sustainable workforce. Additionally, the review highlights how corporate universities can leverage e-recruitment and AI to identify, nurture, and retain top talent, thereby contributing to the long-term sustainability of the organization. The insights gathered from this systematic literature review provide a comprehensive understanding of the opportunities and challenges associated with the intersection of e-recruitment, AI, and GHRM in the context of corporate university sustainability.

articleTitle: Integrating Religious Values in Psychological Consultation Applications: An Evaluation of User Acceptance Using Design Thinking
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Mental health is an important part of being healthy, and Indonesia has a high prevalence rate of mental health problems. With limited clinical psychologists in the country, this study aims to develop a mobile application for psychological consultations based on Islamic principles that can address this gap. This app wants to provide a safe place where users can talk about their mental well-being both from a psychological perspective and from a spiritual standpoint making it easy to fill the gap between psychiatric services and religious guidance. For designing the app, design thinking approach was employed which is user-centeredness in nature with emphases on empathy and iterative development. The five main phases of design thinking were define, ideate, prototype, test, and empathizes. This way they learnt about the experiences and challenges by persons having mental disorders through qualitative research approaches. The problem statement was formulated during the define phase revealing that there was need for an Islamic based platform integrating psychological therapy that will be effective enough for Muslim patients. In developing the prototype; emphasis was given on user experience principles as well as user interface guidelines so that it could accommodate many types of users at any time. To assess its effectiveness and ease of use we used System Usability Scale (SUS) and Cognitive Walkthrough respectively with good results.

articleTitle: Digital Marketing Strategy for Customer Loyalty with the Role of Brand Positioning and Trust Mediation
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This Strategically setting digital marketing objectives enables the marketing team and firm to imagine the best techniques and approaches to achieving them. They provide everyone involved with a sense of purpose and direction, ensuring that everyone works towards the same goal. Companies must determine a digital marketing strategy to increase repurchase intention. The purpose of this study is to find out the steps that companies must take in increasing repurchase intention. In previous research, brand positioning variables can affect repurchase intention. Companies that have implemented digital marketing strategies require consumer trust in increasing repurchase intention. The research will be carried out in Small and Medium Enterprises in the scope of Trowulan Mojokerto sculpture craft. Trowulan is the largest sculpture producing city in East Java. This study employed purposive sampling. All prawn farming firms that meet the criteria for this study. This study's data collection techniques included a questionnaire and a literature review. The research instrument utilised in this study was a questionnaire administered to respondents using five Likert scales.

articleTitle: Startup Readiness Level Apps: The Support of Self-Efficacy for Sustainable Entrepreneurial Intention
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Startup Readiness Level (SRL) Apps are applications used for business travel reporting. Used by business students to measure business readiness from the idea stage to business growth. The aim of this research is to measure the impact of SRL Apps on the level of student satisfaction, self-efficacy and supporting sustainable entrepreneurial intention. The research method used was a survey of business teams that interact with SRL Apps through a quantitative questionnaire. Quantitative data is processed using the path analysis approach and SmartPLS statistical tools. The research model was tested in line with the research hypothesis. The research results show that there is a positive impact of perceived usefulness of SRL Apps on satisfaction levels, but it is not able to support students' self-efficacy. Student satisfaction with SRL Apps is seen as good in supporting sustainable entrepreneurial intention through the mediation of self-efficacy. Students' confidence in running a business result from increased self-efficacy, this is supported by the level of student satisfaction with the performance of SRL Apps. This research shows the importance of technology support in supporting student business trips.

articleTitle: Overlock Thread Stock Opname System Using UHF RFID Technology, OpenCV and Web-Based Application
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research focuses on developing an innovative stock opname system using UHF RFID and OpenCV technology. The main objective is to improve the efficiency and accuracy of stock monitoring and recording processes, addressing common issues such as time-consuming and error-prone manual methods. The research employs the prototyping method, involving iterative stages of system development and refinement. The system leverages UHF RFID for automatic data capture, streamlining the process of tracking incoming and outgoing stock. Additionally, OpenCV technology is integrated for real-time color detection, enabling color-based stock status verification. The data is processed and monitored through a web application, allowing users to access real-time updates and detailed stock information remotely. Preliminary results from black box testing showed a 100% conformity level, while user acceptance tests indicated an 86.55% satisfaction rate. This demonstrates that the system effectively improves the overall stock management process by providing more efficient, accurate, and automated stock monitoring solutions.

articleTitle: Using Decision Trees, Logistic Regression and Random Forest to Predict Poverty Risk in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The study explores the potential of geospatial AI and the Rajabhat dataset, which includes information on 11,240 individuals from Pathum Thani and Sakaew provinces, to predict and improve progress towards Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) achievement in Thailand. It utilises AI models such as decision trees, random forests, logistic regression, and support vector machines (SVM) to analyse geospatial features and forecast progress towards SDG targets. The findings show that logistic regression and random forest models demonstrate high accuracy levels of over 95% in predicting SDG indicator values. The study also identifies critical geographical factors that significantly impact SDG outcomes. It creates maps to visualise predicted SDG progress at different geographical scales, helping to identify areas that may need targeted interventions. The research concludes by emphasising the effectiveness of AI and geospatial data in supporting evidence-based decision-making for sustainable development, particularly in guiding resource allocation and policy adjustments to accelerate SDG achievement in Thailand.

articleTitle: AI ChatGPT in Academic Information Technology Engineering to Increase the Engagement of Extracurricular Performance from Students with Disabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 12th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) with Natural Language Processing (NLP) has grown rapidly in its usage in many fields. One area it's extensively used is in the academic activity for learning purposes. However, its use in the academic field regarding extracurricular activities for disabled students remains scarce.
